description: This file defines the AOD_LogicHooks class with methods for handling module save, delete, and restore events in SuiteCRM, specifically related to the AOD_Index module.

classes.name: AOD_LogicHooks
classes.description: Class containing logic hook methods for AOD_Index module events in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: saveModuleChanges
methods.description: Handles the save event for modules, indexing the bean if not in the AOD_Index module.

methods.name: saveModuleDelete
methods.description: Handles the delete event for modules, removing the bean from the index if not in the AOD_Index module.

methods.name: saveModuleRestore
methods.description: Handles the restore event for modules, re-indexing the bean if not in the AOD_Index module.
